<summary>
Task: Seismic P/S phase picking on 100 npz traces in /root/data/, output picks to /root/results.csv (file_name, phase, pick_idx). Pass: F1>=0.7 P, F1>=0.6 S with 0.1s tolerance (10 samples at dt=0.01).

Data structure (Turn 2): each npz has data (12000,3) float32, dt=0.01, channels e.g. "DPE,DPN,DPZ". Amplitudes are tiny (~1e-14), so agent scales by 1e10. Also has snr, p_weight, s_weight, distance_km, magnitude, start_time, network/station/location_code.

Approach: SeisBench PhaseNet pretrained models. Available pretrained list retrieved (Turn 3): aq2009, diting, ethz, geofon, instance, iquique, jma, jma_wc, lendb, neic, obs, original, phasenet_sn, pisdl, scedc, stead, volpick.

Turn 4-5: Built /root/pick.py using PhaseNet "scedc" model, scaling data by 1e10, building ObsPy Stream with proper metadata, calling model.classify with P/S threshold 0.3. Ran successfully → 127 picks (69 P, 58 S) over 59 files.

Turn 6-9: Lowered thresholds to 0.15 → 169 picks (93 P, 76 S) over 64 files. Still 36 files with no picks.

Turn 10-11: Inspected missing files — many have low SNR (1.0 on some channels), varied distance/magnitude. Some are broadband channels (BK.DANT.00.BH..., NC.*.EH.*) not just short-period DP.

Turn 12-14: Built ensemble of scedc + stead PhaseNet models, threshold 0.10, merging picks within 10 samples per phase keeping highest probability. Result: 230 picks (117 P, 113 S) over 65 files — coverage barely improved (65 vs 64), just more picks per file.

Turn 15: Debugged a still-missing file (BG.ACR..DP.0215954.npz). Even after 1e10 scaling, data range is only ~3e-4 (very quiet). PhaseNet_P max annotation = 0.10 (just under threshold), PhaseNet_S max = 0.032, PhaseNet_N (noise) = 1.0 at argmax 2824 — model considers the whole trace to be noise. Suggests scaling factor might need to be higher, or per-trace normalization is the issue; PhaseNet's internal normalization may be limited by the tiny raw amplitudes even after ×1e10.

Current state: results.csv has 230 picks across 65 of 100 files. F1 quality unknown (no ground-truth check performed). Agent is investigating why 35 files still yield no picks; likely candidate remedies going forward: increase SCALE further (e.g. 1e12), try different pretrained model, lower threshold further, or force at least top-1 argmax per phase when no threshold pick exists. No terminal/infeasible signal emitted.
</summary>
